name: Asahi
message: 「Nngh！ Nn... Iori-sensei, a little... gentler... Ow... Nnah, augh...」

name: Iori
message: 「Good grief, you pushed yourself way too hard on the first day, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh, I can't put any strength into my body...」
Having wrapped up our secret late-night training, I head back to the room with Asahi in tow.
Three times since I first said we should call it a night.
Asahi kept saying, "I'm still fine" and "I want to keep going," so in the end I had to forcibly take her sword away to put a stop to the training.

name: Iori
message: 「This training isn't the kind of thing where just recklessly throwing yourself at it is enough, you know？」
The moment training ended, Asahi collapsed to the floor and couldn't move an inch from that spot.
So right now, I'm lending her my shoulder and practically dragging her back to her room.

name: Iori
message: 「Plenty of athletes have cut their careers short with reckless training, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I thought I could handle this much, though...」

name: Iori
message: 「No, a normal person wouldn't even last ten minutes, okay？」
Even I could only keep up that regimen for about five minutes when I first started learning it, yet Asahi actually kept going for over an hour.
It was an extraordinary display of endurance.

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, that training works muscles you don't normally use. It should get a bit easier from next time on, but don't overdo it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, next time I'll aim to keep going for three hours!」

name: Iori
message: 「...If you're going to be that reckless, I'm calling off the training.」

name: Asahi
message: 「N-No way...」
The way she looks up at me with teary, glistening eyes is strangely cute.
Her flushed, sweat-dampened cheeks, and when I glance down, the chest slightly showing through her sweat-soaked clothes... No, not that.
I give my head a light shake, banishing the impure thoughts to the back of my mind.

name: Iori
message: 「If you're working muscles that even someone who trains as hard as you doesn't use, that means they're muscles you normally don't need.」

name: Iori
message: 「Build them up too much and your body will get heavier, and your movements will get sluggish too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I see... And here I thought it would make me stronger...」
Asahi hanging her head with a face so dejected I could practically see a gloomy sound effect floating beside her.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry, I'm sure that technique suits you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Just don't tell anyone about it, alright?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, a secret just between the two of us, Iori-sensei... Heheheh!」
Well, as long as Asahi's happy, I guess it's fine.
...Though that's definitely not the face a young maiden should be making.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, drool, you’re drooling.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Eh? I-I’m not drooling... am I?」
Asahi tilts her head toward me with a movement that sounds like it ought to be accompanied by a creaking noise.

name: Iori
message: 「No, if you say so, then wipe it off quickly... alright？」

name: Asahi
message: 「N-no, um... I can’t seem to lift my arm...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah... I see. Well, that can't be helped then.」
I reach out and wipe the corner of her mouth with my thumb.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hauhh！？ —gh, hngh.」
Asahi lets out a small whimper, likely because the pain flared up when she reflexively tried to move her body.
―Yeah, let’s stop making that sound. Seriously. I never thought I’d need this much self―control as a teacher.

name: Iori
message: 「At this rate, tomorrow will have to be a rest day.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Eh？ N-no, that’s not allowed. Please keep training me tomorrow as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, I don't think you'll be able to move properly with that muscle pain.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ll manage somehow, just by sheer willpower!」

name: Iori
message: 「You can’t just rely on willpower to fix things like that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't rush, you need to rest properly first. Besides, this isn't the kind of thing you can just master easily.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But we don't have much time left until the Martial Festival... I have to practice as much as I can...！」

name: Iori
message: 「I know, but even so...」
I understand how she feels, but it'll all be for nothing if she actually ruins her body.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, please. I promise I won't overdo it. I really, really want to continue our special training...」

name: Asahi
message: 「If an ordinary person like me wants to go up against someone extraordinary, I have to work twice as hard.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I don’t want to regret doing nothing. Can’t you please, somehow...？」
She looks up at me with tears glistening in the corners of her eyes.

name: Iori
message: 「...Alright, I get it. Only because you’re the one asking, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Eh? Then... does that mean we can train?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, but there’s no way we can do it the way you are now.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you loosen up those sore muscles, ice them, and manage to recover enough to move by tomorrow, then we’ll see.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood! I'll recover through sheer willpower!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, you can't just use willpower for that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I know where you're hurt, and I can encourage an effective recovery by loosening up the muscles.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Really？ I would love for you to do that.」

name: Iori
message: 「But back then, I was the one receiving the massage. I've never given one to anyone.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...By any chance, is this leading to a situation where I get to be massaged by Iori-sensei?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, this is a huge opportunity knocking.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I'm not thinking about anything inappropriate, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I'll take your word for it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course, if Iori―sensei ever gets into the mood, I'm prepared to gladly offer my body to―」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I was wrong to believe you. Part of a teacher's job is to stop their student's runaway imagination.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then let's hurry back to the room.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's fine, but I'm not the one doing the massage.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But you're the only one who knows the technique, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll manage somehow, by asking someone else or...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, if you leave me here, I won't be able to move a single step until morning and I'll stay collapsed on the floor, you know?」

name: Iori
message: 「But it requires direct skin-to-skin contact, and the spot is on your back. Being alone with a practically naked student is a bit...」

name: Asahi
message: 「I understand, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, you understand?」

name: Asahi
message: 「There is a way for Iori-sensei to directly knead my body from head to toe without leaving a single spot untouched.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wh-I have a bad feeling about this...」

name: Iori
message: 「...So, how did it end up like this.」
After preparing in the room and deciding to start the procedure, I muttered in agony.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei？ I'm ready whenever you are. I'll be in your care.」

name: Iori
message: 「O-oh... alright. Let's get started, then.」
That said, my vision was pitch black; I couldn't see a thing.
A massage was unavoidable in this situation, but since I refused to look at the student's naked body, this was the compromise Asahi offered.
Yes, a blindfold.

name: Iori
message: （I can't see anything！ I have no clue where Asahi's body is exactly...！？）

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll guide your hands, Iori-sensei. That way, you can touch wherever you'd like.」

name: Iori
message: 「Make sure you actually guide me to where I asked, alright？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, don't worry. I might slip a little lower or drift to the side, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't mess around too much, or the massage is off. Even as it stands, if a picture were taken of this, I'd be finished in one shot, you know?」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's fine. If that happens, I'll just hold a press conference to properly explain that we're a consenting couple.」
Yeah, that would be my life ruined right there.

name: Iori
message: 「Forget it, let's just get started.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, Iori-sensei, please place your hands right there.」
I slowly lowered my hands and made contact with her skin.

name: Asahi
message: 「Fah... nnn...」
I wonder, where exactly is this？
Judging by the position of her voice and the posture she instructed, I'd guess her waist or back, but...
I slid my fingertips along, feeling for the contours to find my position.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Ngh, being stroked is a little ticklish. U, fu... ah...！？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-what's wrong？ Did I touch somewhere I shouldn't have！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「N-no... my heart just starts pounding when I think about how it's Iori-sensei touching me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Your fingertips feel so cool against my flushed skin... it feels good... nnn...」

name: Iori
message: 「D-don't put it that way...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, gu... that's a bit sore. Nnn, please forgive me if my whole body keeps twitching... it's just...」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's because of the muscle aches...」

name: Iori
message: 「I know that, but watch how you phrase things！」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's just that my body is so sore from the secret training with Iori-sensei...」
I mean, Asahi, are you doing this on purpose？

name: Iori
message: 「A-anyway... the muscles are here, right？ The trapezius... man, Asahi, you're really well-trained！」
Even as I thought to myself that this wasn't the kind of thing one should say to a girl in her prime, I knew that if I didn't do something like this, my focus would drift in a very wrong direction.
Even so, precisely because I couldn't see, I was all the more conscious of the firm, fine-textured skin I could feel with my palms.

name: Asahi
message: 「Nn, ahh... yes, I’m... happy...」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm checking the shape and positioning, so please bear with it for a bit.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, please, rub as much as you like. You don't just have to rub, you can even take advantage of the momentum and... ravage me...」

name: Iori
message: 「A-sa-hi？」
While retorting, I grasped the general positioning and began loosening the tension from the outside with slow, rubbing motions.
Her back was abnormally tense, and she had developed muscle pain.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, ah... my back is still so hot, even though some time has passed since the special training... haa, fuah...」

name: Iori
message: 「Tell me if it hurts. Cooling it is also effective, but if you cool your back down too much, you'll ruin your body.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry I don't have any secret medicine or anything. You have patches, right, Asahi? Shall we put one on later?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes... ah, aun！？ Guh, nn... Iori-sensei's hands... they feel so... good... nhaa...」

name: Iori
message: 「Look, Asahi, I don't mind that it feels good, but... could you, uh, keep it down a bit？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm sorry, but it really feels so good... haa... Iori-sensei, please... make it stronger...」
Gah, I feel like because I can't see, it’s all the more stuck in my ears！

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, fuu... ah, that's amazing...！ In such a short time, my body feels like it's gotten lighter than before...」
Clear your mind. Just clear your mind.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, u... you're working... on such small areas. Nn, I can't help but... flinch... fuah！ I can feel it... ahn！」

name: Iori
message: 「...I know it’s ticklish, but you have to bear with it.」
The sensation of her soft, damp-with-sweat skin, the sound of Asahi gasping. Even though I shouldn't be able to see it, I feel like I can see Asahi's body...

name: Iori
message: 「Alright... I'm starting to remember it...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Nn-u, Iori-sensei, who gave you this massage back in the day？」

name: Iori
message: 「My grandfather. I told you I used to get injured too, right？ I'm just recalling how it was back then.」
I rely on the memory of how my back felt when my grandfather rubbed it to recall the technique.

name: Iori
message: 「...Alright. I think that's enough for the trapezius. The issue is the erector spinae underneath. Since they’re internal muscles, it's tricky.」

name: Iori
message: 「If I remember correctly... it starts from near the underarm, right？ Asahi, I need to shift my position a bit. Is the underarm right here？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes... please slide your hand down along that path.」
They are muscles that are constantly tense, but they get especially fatigued during intense training. I stimulate them by pressing with my palm from near the underarm.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, ugh...！？ H-haaaa... It’s so hot. It feels like you’re touching the inside of my body directly...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Apparently, you’re supposed to use muscle to press and loosen up muscle. I hope I’m doing this right...」

name: Asahi
message: 「You’re doing it so well... ha-fah, nnngh...」

name: Iori
message: 「What’s wrong, does it hurt？」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, it doesn’t hurt at all... actually, I want you to touch me more... ugh, my chest... a little further down.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, I wonder if it’s working. Let’s keep going a bit more.」
Try not to dig your fingers in... don't apply force, just press. I continue, repeating the motion while keeping the positions of the muscles in my mind.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, fuuh... just like that, all the way to the end... ah, no... don’t mind me, just keep... haa-ugh...」

name: Iori
message: 「Phew, is there anywhere else that’s sore？ Don’t hesitate to tell me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Further... down there is... it’s a bit sensitive. More firmly... yes, rub it... no, massage it.」
It seems she’s even managed to overwork her pectoral muscles. I stretch my hand down as I’d imagined.

name: Asahi
message: 「Aah♪ Nn... yes, right around there... especially.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, this area is difficult, isn’t it？ There seems to be something... quite soft in the way.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Take your time, it’s fine. If you rub it, I’m sure it’ll... be okay. Haa, ah...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Rub... wait, the point of this is to loosen the muscles, rubbing isn’t really...」
...Something’s not right. What’s being transmitted to my palm is a squishy, bouncy, soft—

name: Iori
message: 「I-is that what this is！？」
I hurriedly pull my hand away from that part of Asahi.

name: Asahi
message: 「Uuu... that’s a shame. I wanted you to touch it a little longer...」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-you idiot, that was a boob, wasn't it！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, it was the pectoralis major.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that’s absolutely wrong! That didn’t feel like muscle, did it？ Muscles don’t feel all squishy and bouncy, do they？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, you really do remember how it feels. Iori-sensei has memorized the feel of me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi？ Didn't I say no treatment if you mess around too much？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm sorry... I'm not messing around...」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that makes it even worse, you know？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, if the person you like is touching you slowly and thoroughly, you end up thinking about naughty things... don't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm not thinking about them—I'm definitely not thinking about them！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Staaare...」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, tell me what you're looking at！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, Iori-sensei, you hid it... Did it get bigger...？」

name: Iori
message: 「It didn't!!」
Seriously, what an outrageous girl...！

name: Iori
message: 「Enough already, let's just hurry up and finish the rest. You want to do special training tomorrow too, right？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, please take care of me!」
At times like this, she's just as obedient as when she was little. Asahi... How did you turn into a girl like this...
As I kept moving my hands while thinking about that, the treatment was mostly finished.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, that should pretty much do it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Huh？ Oh...！ Iori-sensei, it doesn't hurt at all anymore. It really feels so much better...！」

name: Iori
message: 「You should probably be able to move fine now, though pushing yourself is strictly off-limits.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood. I promise not to push myself.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Um, wouldn't you like to touch me just a little at the end？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm not touching you! Just hurry up and put your clothes on!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, what a shame.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...It's been a while since we went for a walk together, Iori-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Cooling down is important. We put compresses on too, so you should be fine.」
After exercising, rather than resting completely all at once, moving your body a bit while slowly returning to a normal state helps you recover from fatigue faster.
And while I'm at it, I need to cool my own head down too.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san, this is a date, isn't it? Having a private, secret training session that’s also a date... it’s like a dream.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I suppose it might be.」

name: Asahi
message: 「……I’m glad. You look well, Iori-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Me？ I’m the same as always.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But when you were at the academy, you didn’t look like it. You didn’t seem very happy.」
—Ah, that. I was remembering a lot of things, that's why.

name: Asahi
message: 「Actually…… I received a phone call from my brother the other day.」

name: Iori
message: 「……From Takahisa？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. He’s doing well now, working as an instructor at the dojo. He was worried about whether I was doing okay.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see……」

name: Asahi
message: 「Um, have you heard from my brother……？」
I shake my head silently.
A long time has passed since then, and in the meantime, I have grown completely estranged from Takahisa.

name: Asahi
message: 「……I know it might be presumptuous of me to say this, but…… my brother is doing fine.」

name: Asahi
message: 「So, I don't think you need to feel burdened by guilt anymore, Iori-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi…… thank you.」
I think I understand Asahi's consideration all too well. She's been worrying about me, all this time.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san……」
With a quick motion, Asahi straightens her posture and stares straight at me.

name: Asahi
message: 「I will be the one to clear my brother's regrets. I will become a Toujinegi and fulfill my brother's dream.」

name: Asahi
message: 「So…… please, don't carry this burden anymore, Iori-san.」
She speaks each word firmly, like a declaration of resolve, but her eyes alone are wavering with anxiety.

name: Iori
message: 「—You're reliable, Asahi.」
But…… sorry, Asahi, but I can't accept that offer of yours.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, you mustn't fight for my sake or for Takahisa's.」

name: Iori
message: 「I appreciate the sentiment, but that’s a problem between me and Takahisa. It’s not something you should have to shoulder.」

name: Iori
message: 「Both Takahisa and I are grown adults. We’ll resolve it between the two of us eventually.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san……」

name: Iori
message: 「I want Asahi to grasp her own dream. I want her to spread her wings and follow her heart」
As long as people are alive, they are bound to carry shackles.
Restraints can sometimes become a source of strength, but more often than not, they are not. I just want Asahi to fight without any regrets.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, in other words―I want you to do what you want to do, without worrying about grown―up complications」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Thank you, Iori-san」

name: Iori
message: 「—Though, don't overdo it with the special training」

name: Iori
message: 「If Asahi ends up getting injured from overtraining, I’m certain Takahisa will kill me」

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s alright, I’ll kill my brother if that happens」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re scary, Asahi」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe」
Asahi gave me a smile that looked as if she had finally found clarity, and gave a small, polite bow.

name: Asahi
message: 「……Well then, I’ll head back and get some rest. Goodnight, Iori-san」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, goodnight. Asahi」
With a bright smile, Asahi turned and headed back to the dormitory.
